title: RNA Normalization I & II
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol preps and runs a PCR on the Opentrons thermocycler using a .csv input. RNA and NF water are added to the PCR plate, and mastermix is then added to the resulting solution and mixed. A pause is included after the RNA is added to the water in the thermocycler plate, and the user is prompted to replace the water plate with the same 96 well plate, but with mastermix in column 1. If the protocol runs out of tips, it will automatically stop and the user is prompted to replace tips. For csv information and formatting notes, see below. Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of columns`: Specify the number of columns in the thermocycler plate to dispense mastermix into. Mastermix will always come from column 1 of the 96 well plate on slot 3. The mastermix plate will replace with water plate on slot 3 after an automatic pause in the protocol. * `.CSV File`: Here, you should upload a .csv file formatted in the following way, being sure to include the header line (use slot 7 for the thermocycler slot, and input an "x" for values that are not needed in that row): * `Pipette Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P20 Single, and Multi-channel pipettes, respectively. ---

steps.title: Prepare CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: Create a .csv worklist that includes a header line, assign the thermocycler to slot 7, use "x" for unused values, specify the number of columns to dispense mastermix, and indicate pipette mounts (left for P20 single‑channel, right for P20 multichannel). Mastermix will be taken from column 1 of the 96‑well plate placed on slot 3.

steps.title: Pre‑cool thermocycler
steps.instruction: Set the Opentrons thermocycler to 4 °C and allow it to equilibrate before adding any liquids.

steps.title: Add NF water to wells
steps.instruction: Using the P20 single‑channel pipette on the designated mount, dispense the volume of nuclease‑free (NF) water specified in the CSV (e.g., 11 µL to well A1, 12 µL to well E7) from the reservoir located in slot 3 into each corresponding well of the 96‑well PCR plate that is seated in the thermocycler. Repeat for all samples, up to 96 wells.

steps.title: Add RNA to wells
steps.instruction: Using the same P20 single‑channel pipette, transfer the RNA volume indicated in the CSV (e.g., 5 µL from the tube in slot 4 A1 to PCR well A1, 4 µL from slot 2 A1 to well E7). Ensure that the sum of NF water volume (x µL) and RNA volume (y µL) equals 16 µL for each well.

steps.title: Pause and replace plate with mastermix
steps.instruction: The protocol will pause automatically after the RNA addition. Remove the water plate from slot 3 and replace it with the same 96‑well plate that now contains VILO Master Mix in column 1 (mastermix source). Confirm the plate is seated correctly before resuming.

steps.title: Add VILO Master Mix and mix
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multichannel pipette on the designated mount, pick up fresh tips for each destination column. Dispense 4 µL of VILO Master Mix into every well of the column, then gently mix the well contents 4 times with a 12 µL aspiration/dispense volume.

substeps.instruction: For each column up to the specified number of columns, repeat the dispense‑and‑mix operation.

steps.title: Replace tips if depleted
steps.instruction: If the protocol stops because the tip rack is empty, pause, load a new tip rack onto the deck, and resume the run.

steps.title: Seal plate and run thermocycler
steps.instruction: Seal the PCR plate securely, then start the thermocycler program: 25 °C for 10 seconds, 50 °C for 10 minutes, and 85 °C for 5 minutes.
